entities.name: Dovid
entities.description: A wounded cathar of the Pale who becomes Comitant to the angels of the Lofts, narrates the journal and learns the church's secret.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: The angel who returned to guide humanity and who appoints Dovid as comitant; a journal reveals she was created by Sorin.

entities.name: Gryta
entities.description: A short angel with human-like brown eyes who guides Dovid and relays Avacyn's instructions.

entities.name: Mikaeus Cecani
entities.description: A Lunarch whose name is on the frontispiece of a journal of the church's secrets.

entities.name: Griselbrand
entities.description: A demon who was sealed in the Helvault with Avacyn.

entities.name: E. Markov
entities.description: A figure who brokered the creation of vampires and with his sons trapped and drained the angel Marycz.

entities.name: Sorin Markov
entities.description: An ancient and powerful member of the Markov family who created Avacyn, per the journal.

entities.name: Shilgengar
entities.description: A demon who devised with Markov the formula that turned men into vampires.

entities.name: Marycz
entities.description: An angel trapped and exsanguinated by Markov and his sons to create the first vampires.

entities.name: Eost
entities.description: A mortuary sword forged from silver of the Helvault, presented to Dovid by Avacyn.

entities.name: Helvault
entities.description: The prison that sealed Avacyn and Griselbrand and later split; its silver is forged into swords.

entities.name: Nightfall Cathars
entities.description: A group whose spell binds the secret journal Dovid finds.

entities.name: Vampires
entities.description: Creatures created by Markov with angel's blood who feed on humans and whose existence the church uses to cultivate humans.

entities.name: Lofts of Thraben Cathedral
entities.description: The long-abandoned upper halls of the cathedral where the angels will return and Dovid prepares the space.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: The plane where Avacyn has returned and the church is resurgent.

events.summary: Flashback: wounded at the battle of Child's Wall, Dovid lies feverish in the cathedral courtyard after Avacyn appears.
events.quote: and then a blinding light when, at last, Avacyn appeared.

events.summary: Avacyn, with the angel Gryta, summons Dovid and orders him to prepare the forbidden space of the Lofts of Thraben Cathedral.
events.quote: You, and you alone, must prepare that space previously forbidden.

events.summary: Dovid becomes Comitant Dovid, isolated from the cathars and church officials, carrying the first sword forged from the Helvault.
events.quote: That is how I became Comitant Dovid.

events.summary: Gryta opens a bricked window into the Lofts for Dovid and tells him to clear the cistern.
events.quote: The bricked window folded into itself silently

events.summary: Dovid is given Eost, a sword forged from the Helvault, with his name at the top of the honored list.
events.quote: I have drawn it only once, during the ceremony where it was presented to me, when Avacyn touched its point.

events.summary: In the cistern Dovid finds a preserved, strangled man in black with a book in his coat, which he seals in a nameless crypt and takes the book.
events.quote: He had been strangled, and although there were no signs of rot, he was murdered some time before

events.summary: Dovid solves the Nightfall Cathars' spell on the journal and learns that Avacyn had been sealed with Griselbrand and that church power diminished, a secret kept from the congregation.
events.quote: Avacyn had been sealed in the Helvault with the demon Griselbrand, and during that time our power had diminished.

events.summary: The journal reveals vampires were created by humans: Markov and the demon Shilgengar used an angel's blood, after trapping and draining Marycz.
events.quote: Markov and his sons trapped the angel Marycz in his laboratory and exsanguinated her

events.summary: The journal says Sorin created Avacyn to hold the vampires in check and that the church keeps humans as livestock, never able to defeat them; Dovid concludes his faith is a lie.
events.quote: We are livestock. We are unwitting participants in our own cultivation.

relations.note: According to the journal, Sorin created Avacyn to rally the remaining angels.
relations.quote: Sorin created Avacyn, a force to rally our remaining angels
I am your servant, and your will is mine.
She will show you the way, and relay our instructions in the days to come.

relations.note: Markov and his sons exsanguinated the angel to create vampires.
relations.quote: Markov and his sons trapped the angel Marycz in his laboratory and exsanguinated her

relations.note: Markov brokered the blasphemy that created vampires.
relations.quote: E. Markov brokered the blasphemy that created his foul race of vampires.
Avacyn had been sealed in the Helvault with the demon Griselbrand
